channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: US personnel killed in ISIS ambush during Syria engagement
item.description: Two US service members and a US civilian interpreter were killed in Syria on 13 December after an ambush by a lone ISIS gunman, according to US Central Command. The post US personnel killed in ISIS ambush during Syria engagement first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Grangemouth ethylene plant backed amid defence resilience concerns
item.description: Speaking to the UK Defence Journal at Grangemouth, Chancellor Rachel Reeves said the ethylene cracker is “absolutely essential for our national security” and a key part of UK critical infrastructure. The post Grangemouth ethylene plant backed amid defence resilience concerns first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Huge new British warship powers up for the first time
item.description: HMS Glasgow has begun generating her own power, with the Type 26’s diesel generators switched on for the first time. The post Huge new British warship powers up for the first time first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK Export Finance expansion backed as MPs debate subsidies
item.description: Parliament has debated plans to expand the capacity of UK Export Finance (UKEF), with MPs from across the House backing support for exporters while differing sharply on the role of subsidies, Brexit and regional priorities. The post UK Export Finance expansion backed as MPs debate subsidies first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Doubt cast on Ajax role in meeting NATO commitments
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has declined to give a clear assurance that the British Army can meet its NATO armoured reconnaissance obligations without the Ajax programme. The post Doubt cast on Ajax role in meeting NATO commitments first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Russia, Iran and China pose ‘multi-faceted’ UK threat, MPs warn
item.description: Hostile activity by Russia, Iran and China has intensified and now represents a complex, persistent threat to the UK, according to a new assessment published by Parliament’s Intelligence and Security Committee. The post Russia, Iran and China pose ‘multi-faceted’ UK threat, MPs warn first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Joint Expeditionary Force ‘key tool’ to deter Russia
item.description: Asked by Graeme Downie MP, ministers said the UK-led Joint Expeditionary Force remains key to deterring Russian threats in the High North. The post Joint Expeditionary Force ‘key tool’ to deter Russia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: First of seven new Scottish ferries start build in Poland
item.description: A keel-laying ceremony was held for the first ferry, while steel was cut for the second, confirming that the Small Vessel Replacement Programme has moved into full production. The post First of seven new Scottish ferries start build in Poland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK review may examine Iranian influence in Scotland
item.description: An independent UK review into foreign political interference could examine Iranian-linked activity targeting online debate around Scottish independence, following comments by Scotland Secretary Douglas Alexander. The review was announced after a former MEP was jailed for accepting Russian bribes and is expected to examine a wide range of foreign influence mechanisms, including covert digital operations. […] The post UK review may examine Iranian influence in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence

item.title: UK sends turrets and missiles in £600m Ukraine air push
item.description: The UK has announced a £600 million package of air-defence support for Ukraine, including automated counter-drone turrets and additional missile systems. The post UK sends turrets and missiles in £600m Ukraine air push first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
